rows.author: E058
rows.title_full: AN ACT AMENDING THE CHARTER OF THE PHILIPPINE CHARITY SWEEPSTAKES OFFICE, AS AMENDED, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: The bill seeks to redirect a portion of the charity fund of the Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office (PCSO) to government institutions that implement social welfare and health programs. It grants the Department of Health and the Department of Social Welfare and Development 15% and 10% share, respectively, of the charity fund of the PCSO to finance their priority programs.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on GOVERNMENT ENTERPRISES AND PRIVATIZATION since 2004-07-28

rows.author: E058
rows.title_full: AN ACT CONVERTING THE POBLACION-COLINE-SULONG-CRUZ, SAN MIGUEL ROAD IN THE MUNICIPALITY OF ALIMODIAN, PROVINCE OF ILOILO, INTO A NATIONAL ROAD AND APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on PUBLIC WORKS AND HIGHWAYS since 2004-07-28

rows.author: E058
rows.title_full: AN ACT CONVERTING THE ROAD LEADING TO THE SEVEN CITIES POB-CAGAY-CABACANAN PROPER ROAD IN THE MUNICIPALITY OF ALIMODIAN, IN THE PROVINCE OF ILOILO, INTO A NATIONAL ROAD AND APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on PUBLIC WORKS AND HIGHWAYS since 2004-07-28

rows.author: E058
rows.title_full: AN ACT INSTITUTING POLICIES AND MEASURES FOR THE PREVENTION, CONTROL AND TREATMENT OF SEVERE ACUTE RESPIRATORY SYNDROME (SARS), PROVIDING FUNDS THEREOF, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.title_short: Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome (SARS) Prevention, Control and Treatment Act of 2004
rows.abstract: \"Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome (SARS) Prevention, Control and Treatment Act of 2004.\" The proposed bill seeks to institute policies and measures to control, prevent and treat SARS through an information and education campaign, the establishment of a SARS Isolation Center and Airport Quarantine Area and the creation of a Philippine National SARS Council. It also seeks the establishment of a comprehensive SARS monitoring program or \"Bantay SARS\".
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on HEALTH since 2004-07-28

rows.author: E058
rows.mother_status: Printed copies distributed to members on 2007-01-22
rows.title_full: AN ACT CHANGING THE SCHOOL OPENING AND BEGINNING OF CLASSES TO THE FIRST MONDAY OF SEPTEMBER OF EVERY SCHOOL YEAR AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: At present, the school opening, which starts on the first week of June, falls within the rainy and typhoon season. The bill proposes to change the school opening and the beginning of classes to the first Monday of September each year. This will make our school opening consistent with the rest of the world and avoid the difficulties experienced by school children during the rainy season.
rows.status: Substituted by HB05725

rows.author: E058
rows.title_full: AN ACT BANNING THE IMPORTATION AND DUMPING OF ALL KINDS OF TOXIC WASTES AND MATERIALS INTO THE COUNTRY, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.title_short: Toxic Wates and Materials Ban Act of 2003
rows.abstract: \"Toxic Wastes and Materials Ban Act of 2003'\" The Philippines has been tagged as the toxic wastes \"dumping capital\" of the world. The measure seeks to implement a total ban on all kinds and forms of toxic wastes and materials for recycling or for any other use and purpose from entering the country. Likewise, revokes permits issued to any individual or corporation for the importation of toxic wastes and materials.
rows.status: Substituted by HB05717

rows.author: E058
rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR THE SECURITY AND PROTECTION OF VENDORS IN THE WORKPLACE AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: The recent drive of the Metro Manila Development Authority (MMDA) to rid major thoroughfares of street vendors and hawkers has adversely affected the livelihood and sustenance of these vendors and their families. The bill seeks to provide security and protection to vendors in their workplaces. An Inter-Agency Council on the Security and Protection of Registered Vendors shall be created to formulate and implement policies and programs for registered vendors nationwide.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on TRADE AND INDUSTRY since 2004-07-28

rows.author: E058
rows.title_full: AN ACT CREATING A WORLD TRADE ORGANIZATION (WTO) AFFAIRS STRATEGY OFFICE (WTO-ASO) UNDER THE OFFICE OF THE PRESIDENT AND APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR
rows.abstract: The World Trade Organization (WTO), the final forum for international trade disputes, has a set of detailed and complex rules and regulations. A thorough review and study of the dynamics of the game within the WTO is called for. The bill proposes the creation of a WTO Affairs Strategy Office under the Office of the President to formulate a set of policies to be adopted by the government concerning WTO matters and affairs and its rules on engagement.
rows.status: Under study by the Technical Working Group(TWG) on 2006-11-15

committee_action.action: Under study by the Technical Working Group(TWG) on 2006-08-14
Under study by the Technical Working Group(TWG) on 2006-11-15

rows.author: E058
rows.title_full: AN ACT CREATING THE OVERSEAS FILIPINO WORKERS (OFW) MEDICAL CENTER DEFINING ITS POWERS AND FUNCTIONS, APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: The bill seeks the establishment, operation and maintenance of a medical center for overseas Filipino workers (OFWs) and their families. The Center shall extend medical services to OFWs and their families to help prevent, relieve or alleviate their innumerable medical afflictions and maladies. The measure provides for the government to contribute the land, building, equipment and facilities for the Center.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on HEALTH since 2004-07-28

rows.author: E058
rows.title_full: AN ACT CREATING THE PHILIPPINE COAST GUARD AUXULIARY, PROVIDING FUNDS THEREOF AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: The Philippine Coast Guard Auxiliary (PCGA) is an indispensable collaborator of the Philippine Coast Guard in promoting the safety of life and property at sea, safeguarding the marine environment and resources, and enforcing maritime laws. The bill seeks to establish the role and mandate of the PCGA, to define the administrative powers of its officers over the organization and to institute mechanisms for a democratic procedure of selecting officers and commanders.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on TRANSPORTATION since 2005-01-12

rows.author: E058
rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR A MANDATORY CLEARANCE FOR ALL GOVERNMENT OFFICIALS UPON THEIR RETIREMENT FROM PUBLIC OFFICE, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.title_short: Honorable Dismissal of Government Employees Act of 2003
rows.abstract: \"Honorable Dismissal of Government Employees Act of 2003.\" This bill seeks to grant government officials, who shall retire from public service, retirements benefits provided he/she has no pending criminal, civil or administrative case. It also provides that all retiring government officials must be subjected to a clearance system for purposes of accountability.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on CIVIL SERVICE AND PROFESSIONAL REGULATION since 2004-07-28

rows.author: E058
rows.title_full: AN ACT MANDATING THE USE OF THE PROCEEDS FROM GROSS RECEIPTS TAX IMPOSED ON CELLULAR PHONE COMPANIES TO FINANCE THE COMPUTER LITERACY PROGRAMS OF PUBLIC SCHOOLS AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: This bill proposes the creation of a special computer literacy education fund from the gross receipts tax imposed on cellular phone companies. The fund is intended to support the computer literacy program in public schools, from the  elementary to the tertiary levels.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on APPROPRIATIONS since 2004-07-28

principal_referral.committee: MICRO, SMALL AND MEDIUM ENTERPRISE DEVELOPMENT

rows.author: E058
rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR THE CREATION OF A SPECIAL EDUCATION FUND INTENDED FOR SCHOOL BUILDINGS AND FACILITIES, TO BE ALLOCATED FROM THE EXCISE TAX COLLECTION ON ALCOHOL AND TOBACCO PRODUCTS, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: Classroom shortage compel teachers to hold their classes in make-shift shelters. The proposed measure seeks to augment the present budget for this purpose through the creation of a Special Education Fund for School Buildings and Facilities to be sourced from the excise tax collection on alcoholic products (distilled spirits, wines and fermented liquor) and tobacco products (cigars and cigarettes).
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on APPROPRIATIONS since 2004-07-28

principal_referral.committee: MICRO, SMALL AND MEDIUM ENTERPRISE DEVELOPMENT

rows.author: E058
rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR THE ALLOCATION OF THE DEPARTMENT OF EDUCATION-SCHOOL BUILDING PROGRAM BUDGET, ENSURING BUDGET PRIORITY FOR THE CONSTRUCTION AND MAINTENANCE OF SCHOOL BUILDINGS AND CLASSROOMS, REPEALING REPUBLIC ACT NO. 7880, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE FAIR AND EQUITABLE ACCESS TO EDUCATION ACT AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: The proposed measure provides for the allocation of the total budget for the School Building Program to each legislative district according to their classroom shortage as determined by the DepEd's Division Superitendents and District Supervisors. It further proposes that the budget allocation for the construction of school buildings and classrooms be determined based on the population of enrolled students in the elementary and secondary levels divided by forty.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on APPROPRIATIONS since 2004-07-28

rows.author: E058
rows.title_full: AN ACT AMENDING CERTAIN SECTIONS OF BATAS PAMBANSA BILANG 881 OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE OMNIBUS ELECTION CODE OF THE PHILIPPINES
rows.abstract: It can not be denied that barangay elections are used by various political parties and political organizations to provide them with a political machinery. The bill proposes the deletion of Section 38 of the Omnibus Election Code which provides for a non-partisan barangay election. The proposal would finally adapt the law into the political reality  prevalent in this country.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on SUFFRAGE AND ELECTORAL REFORMS since 2004-07-28

rows.author: E058
rows.title_full: AN ACT CREATING THE NATIONAL COMMISSIN ON MUSLIM FILIPINOS DEFINING ITS POWERS, FUNCTIONS AND RESPONSIBILITIES AND APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.title_short: National Commission on Muslim Filipino Act
rows.abstract: \"National Commission on Muslim Filipino Act.\" The measure proposes the creation of the National Commission on Muslim Filipinos to replace and take over the functions of the Office of Muslim Affairs. The Commission is mandated to preserve and develop the culture, tradition, institutions and well-being of Muslim Filipinos in conformity with the country's laws and in consonance with programs to attain national unity and development.
rows.status: Under deliberation by the Mother Committee on 2005-01-19

committee_action.action: Under deliberation by the Mother Committee on 2005-01-19

rows.author: E058
rows.title_full: AN ACT PROHIBITING TELECOMMUNICATIONS COMPANIES, SUCH AS THOSE PROVIDING WIRELESS TELEPHONE SERVICES, FROM SELLING TO THE PUBLIC PRE-PAID AND POST-PAID SUBSCRIPTION PLANS THAT WILL RESULT TO CONSUMER USE EXCEEDING THE PEAK-LOAD CARRYING CAPACITIES OF SUCH COMPANIES, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: Because of the voluminous number of subscribers, consumers of the wireless communications industry have been experiencing poor interconnection, delayed messages and network clogging. The bill seeks to prohibit telecommunication companies from selling to the public pre-paid and post-paid subscription plans that will result to consumer use exceeding the peak-load carrying capacities of such companies.
rows.status: Substituted by HB05283

rows.author: E058
rows.title_full: AN ACT CONVERTING THE WESTERN VISAYAS SANITARIUM AND LEPROSARIUM IN THE MUNICIPALITY OF STA. BARBARA, PROVINCE OF ILOILO INTO THE PRESIDENT DIOSDADO MACAPAGAL HOSPITAL AND RESEARCH INSTITUTE FOR TROPICAL MEDICINE, DEFINING ITS POWERS AND FUNCTIONS, APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on HEALTH since 2004-07-28

rows.author: E058
rows.title_full: AN ACT GRANTING FRANKING PRIVILEGE TO FILIPINO CITIZENS HERE AND ABROAD, TO ENHANCE THEIR PARTICIPATION IN THE TASK OF GOVERNANCE
rows.title_short: Filipino Citizen's Franking Privilege Act of 2004
rows.abstract: \"Filipino Citizen's Franking Privilege Act of 2004.\" To encourage the citizens of our country to communicate their views and opinions and to facilitate prompt and immediate response to a public need, the bill proposes to extend the franking privilege to Filipino citizens here and abroad when addressing their correspondence to any of the three branches of government.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on INFORMATION COMMUNICATIONS TECHNOLOGY since 2005-11-29

rows.author: E058
rows.title_full: AN ACT FIXING THE RETIREMENT AGE OF THE UNIFORMED PERSONNEL OF THE PHILIPPINE NATIONAL POLICE, AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE REPUBLIC ACT NUMBERED SIXTY-NINE HUNDRED AND SEVENTY FIVE OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE \"DEPARTMENT OF THE INTERIOR AND LOCAL GOVERNMENT ACT OF 1990\"
rows.abstract: An early retirement age for our police officers is recommended to: a) give him longer time for his family; and b) provide the next-in-line police officers the opportunity to assume higher ranks. To attain these objectives, the bill seeks to reduce the compulsory retirement age for police officers and non-officers from 56 years old to 54 years old.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on CIVIL SERVICE AND PROFESSIONAL REGULATION since 2004-07-28

rows.author: E058
rows.title_full: AN ACT MANDATING THE FULL IMPLEMENTATION OF THE NATIONAL HEALTH INSURANCE PROGRAM' COMPULSORY COVERAGE FOR ALL FILIPINO RESIDENTS, AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE REPUBLIC ACT 7875 OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE \"NATIONAL HEALTH INSURANCE ACT OF 1995\", AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: The bill mandates the compulsory health insurance coverage of all citizens of the Philippines under the National Health Insurance Program effective immediately.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on HEALTH since 2004-07-28

rows.author: E058
rows.title_full: AN ACT UPRGRADING THE MINIMUM SALARY GRADE LEVEL OF PUBLIC SCHOOL TEACHERS AND F0R OTHER PURPOSE
rows.abstract: Because of their low salary, teachers are forced to deal with loan sharks in order to tide their families over until the next pay check. Some are even obliged to take part-time jobs to provide for their family's basic needs. The bill proposes to upgrade the salary grade (SG) for Teacher I from SG 10 to SG 18 to enable them to cope with the rising cost of living.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on APPROPRIATIONS since 2004-07-28

rows.author: E058
rows.title_full: AN ACT CREATING THE OVERSEAS FILIPINO WORKERS BANK, APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: The bill provides for the establishment of the Overseas Filipino Workers (OFWs) Bank, its powers, functions and organizational structure.  It further sets the authorized capitalization for the Bank at PhP1.5 billion of which PhP500 million shall be offered to OFWs for subscription.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on BANKS AND FINANCIAL INTERMEDIARIES since 2004-07-28

rows.author: E058
rows.title_full: AN ACT CREATING THE OFFICE OF THE GOVERNMENT NEGOTIATOR UNDER THE OFFICE OF THE PRESIDENT, APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: The measure proposes to create the Office of the Government Negotiator which shall act as the sole and principal negotiating office of the government in times of crisis and conflict situations. The Office shall represent the government in the settlement of conflicts involving armed or hostile individuals or groups.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on GOVERNMENT REORGANIZATION since 2004-07-28

rows.author: E058
rows.title_full: AN ACT DECLARING \"FAKE DRUGS\" (MEDICINES) AS DANGEROUS DRUGS AND ITS IMPORTATION, MANUFACTURE, SALE, ADMINISTRATION, DISPENSATION, DELIVERY AND DISTRIBUTION BE CLASSIFIED AS HEINOUS CRIME PUNISHABLE BY DEATH, AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE REPUBLIC ACT NO. 6425, AS AMENDED, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE DANGEROUS DRUGS ACT OF 1972, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: The proliferation and distribution of fake drugs in the market remains unabated. These bogus medicines are not only ineffective but, more importantly, these are life threatening. The measure seeks to classify \"fake drugs\" as dangerous drugs punishable under RA 6425 (Dangerous Drugs Act of 1972). It also seeks to classify its importation, sale, administration, dispensation, delivery and distribution as a heinous crime punishable by death.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on REVISION OF LAWS since 2004-07-28

rows.author: E058
rows.mother_status: Approved by the House on 2006-10-13, transmitted to on 2006-11-09 and received by the Senate on 2006-11-09
rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR STIFF PENALTIES TO THE CRIME OF INFIDELITY OF PUBLIC OFFICERS IN THE CUSTODY OF PRISONERS, AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSES ARTICLE 223 AND 224 OF THE REVISED PENAL CODE, AS AMENDED, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: Same sa HB0005
rows.status: Substituted by HB05609

rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING F0R THE INCLUSION OF BASIC ECONOMIC SUBJECTS AS PART OF THE CURRICULUM OF THE MILITARY AND POLICE COURSE, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: Coup d' etat, as an act of destabilization, gravely affects our political and economic stability. Therefore, it is crucial for our military and police personnel to understand the relevance of economic stability for the country. This bill seeks the inclusion of basic economic subjects in the curriculum of military and police courses to provide an understanding on the effects of destabilizing acts and activities on the country's economy.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on PUBLIC ORDER AND SAFETY since 2004-07-28

rows.author: E058
rows.title_full: AN ACT DECLARING THE FIRST WORKING DAY OF EVERY YEAR, BEGINNING ON THE YEAR 2003, A NATIONAL DAY OF PEACE AND UNITY, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: To inculcate in the minds and hearts of every Filipino a desire for lasting peace and unity, this bill seeks to declare the first working day of every year as \"National Day of Peace and Unity\" and a special non-working holiday.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on REVISION OF LAWS since 2004-07-28

rows.author: E058
rows.title_full: AN ACT ALLOWING PILOTS TO POSSESS FIREARM IN THE AIRCRAFT COCKPIT AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE REPUBLIC ACT NO. 6235 OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE \"ANTI-HIJACKING LAW\" AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: The bill mandates the Department of Transportation and Communications, in coordination with the Philippine Air Force Aviation Security Command, to implement a program wherein qualified pilots of passenger aircrafts would be deputized as enforcement officers and authorized to carry firearms to defend the aircraft from air piracy and hijacking.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on PUBLIC ORDER AND SAFETY since 2004-07-28

rows.author: E058
rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR THE COMPLETION OF THE NICHOLS BRIDGE LOCATED IN THE MUNICIPALITY OF ALIMODIAN, PROVINCE OF ILOILO, APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on PUBLIC WORKS AND HIGHWAYS since 2004-07-28

rows.author: E058
rows.title_full: AN ACT INCREASING THE PENALTIES FOR CHILD ABUSE AND EXPLOITATION, THEREBY DECLARING IT AS HEINOUS CRIME, AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE REPUBLIC ACT NO. 7160 AS AMENDED, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE \"SPECIAL PROTECTION OF CHILDREN AGAINST CHILD ABUSE, EXPLOITATION AND DISCRIMINATION ACT\", AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: The bill seeks to impose the penalty of reclusion perpetua TO DEATH for the crimes of child trafficking and child prostitution.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on REVISION OF LAWS since 2004-07-28

rows.author: E058
rows.title_full: AN ACT CREATING THE BANGSAMORO DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY, DEFINING ITS POWERS, FUNCTIONS AND RESPONSIBILITIES, AND APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: The measure calls for the creation of the Bangsamoro Development Authority (BDA) to implement the socio-economic development plans and programs for the Bangsamoro areas and communities. The BDA shall perform planning, monitoring and coordinative functions and exercise regulatory and supervisory authority over the delivery of socio-economic services in the Mindanao region.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on MUSLIM AFFAIRS since 2004-11-08

rows.author: E058
rows.title_full: AN ACT PROHIBITING THE USE OF \"ASPARTAME\" ON FOOD, BEVERAGES AND DRUGS, AND THE SALE AND DISTRIBUTION OF ARTIFICIAL SWEETENERS, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: \"Aspartame Ban Act of 2004\".  Aspartame accounts for over 75% of the adverse reactions to food additives reported to the US Food and Drugs Administration.  The bill seeks to ban the use of aspartame on food, beverages and drugs such as cereals, gelatin desserts, etc.  It also prohibits the sale and distribution of artificial sweeteners or sugar substitutes like NutraSweet, Equal and other brands.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on HEALTH since 2004-07-28

rows.author: E058
rows.title_full: AN ACT CONVERTING THE NEW LUCENA POLYTECHNIC COLLEGE IN THE MUNICIPALITY OF NEW LUCENA, ILOILO, INTO THE ILOILO STATE UNIVERSITY, APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on HIGHER AND TECHNICAL EDUCATION since 2004-07-28

rows.author: E058
rows.title_full: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A MUSLIM FILIPINO CEMETERY IN METRO MANILA, AND APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR
rows.status: Tabled by the Committee on 2005-04-20

committee_action.action: Tabled by the Committee on 2005-04-20

rows.author: E058
rows.title_full: AN ACT MANDATING ALL PUBLIC AND PRIVATE HOSPITALS TO ESTABLISH AND MAINTAIN AN ISOLATION AND QUARANTINE FACILITY FOR INFECTIOUS DISEASES, PROVIDING FUNDS THEREOF, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: \"Hospital Isolation Facility Act of 2004\".  To reduce, if not entirely contain, the spread of infectious diseases, the bill mandates all government and private hospitals to establish and maintain an isolation and quarantine facility for contagious diseases.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on HEALTH since 2004-07-28

rows.author: E058
rows.title_full: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A LEGAL ATTACHE OFFICE IN THE MIDDLE EAST COUNTRIES AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE REPUBLIC ACT NO. 8042 OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE \"MIGRANT WORKERS AND OVERSEAS FILIPINOS ACT OF 1995\", AND APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR
rows.abstract: As of December 2001, there are 897,000 Filipino workers in Saudi Arabia and 128,604 in the United Arab Emirates. According to Migrante International, at present, there are 44 Filipino workers in various jails in Saudi Arabia facing the possibility of beheading unless the Philippine government intervenes. This measure seeks to provide a remedy to the plight of our migrant workers by establishing a Legal Attache Office in every Middle East country particularly in Saudi Arabia and in the United Arab Emirates.
rows.status: Under deliberation by the Mother Committee on 2006-09-20

committee_action.action: Under deliberation by the Mother Committee on 2006-09-20
committee_action.remarks: Deferred by the Joint Committees on Labor and Employment and Foreign Affairs

rows.author: E058
rows.title_full: AN ACT REGULATING TUITION AND OTHER SCHOOL-RELATED FEES IN ALL HIGHER AND BASIC INSTITUTIONS OF LEARNING, CREATING A TUITION REGULATION BOARD, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: \"Tuition Regulation Act of 2004.\" To broaden the campaign against unreasonable and unwarranted tuition fee increases every academic year, the bill seeks the creation of a Tuition Regulatory Council (TRC) that shall serve as the highest policy making  body on matters concerning tuition fee rates, modification and other tuition related matters. The TRC shall study, conduct consultations and thereafter recommend adjustments in tuition and other school fees.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on HIGHER AND TECHNICAL EDUCATION since 2004-07-28

rows.author: E058
rows.title_full: AN ACT STRENTHENING AND REFORMING THE SANGGUNIANG KABATAAN, AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE SECTIONS 329, 433 AND 434 OF REPUBLIC ACT 7160, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE LOCAL GOVERNMENT CODE OF 1991, APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: \"Sangguniang Kabataan Reform Act of 2004.\" To fully tap the potentials of youth empowerment, the existing organizational structure of the Sangguniang Kabataan (SK) needs to be strengthened and reformed. The bill calls on the sangguniang barangay to appropriate the SK fund in lump sum  and grants the SK fiscal autonomy on its operations as to disbursements and encashment of their income and expenses.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on LOCAL GOVERNMENT since 2004-07-28

rows.author: E004
rows.title_full: AN ACT CREATING THE NATIONAL HEALING, RECONCILIATION AND UNITY COMMISSION AND APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFORE AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.title_short: National Healing, Reconciliation and Unity Act of 2003
rows.abstract: \"National Healing, Reconciliation and Unity Act of 2003.\" The bill proposes the establishment of a National Healing, Reconciliation and Unity Commission which shall have the power to resolve political conflicts and to implement a national reconciliation and unity program, formulate a mechanism to recover ill-gotten wealth of certain individuals and implement a mechanism for redress of victims of political conflicts and determine who shall be entitled to a political amnesty.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on GOVERNMENT REORGANIZATION since 2004-07-28

rows.author: E004
rows.title_full: AN ACT CREATING A ROAD DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY, PROVIDING FUNDS THEREFOR AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: \"Road Development Act of 2004.\" The bill seeks to create the Road Development Authority (RDA) which shall be responsible for the construction and/or rehabilitation, maintenance and operation of selected and desirable infrastructure projects  where there are no takers from the private sector. It grants the RDA the power to raise and/or borrow funds from local and international financial institutions for the purpose of financing its projects and programs.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on PUBLIC WORKS AND HIGHWAYS since 2004-11-08

rows.author: E004
rows.title_full: AN ACT AMENDING ARTICLE 26 OF THE NEW CIVIL CODE TO INCLUDE AS ACTIONABLE WRONG THE DISCLOSURE OR DISSEMINATION TO THIRD PARTIES A MAILING LIST OF PERSONAL INFORMATION OF PERSONS GIVEN IN CONFIDENCE
rows.abstract: The bill seeks to pronounce as an actionable wrong the disclosure, distribution, circulation and/or transmittal, with or without consideration, to third parties, through a mailing list used for commercial purposes, personal information presumed to have been given in confidence by another.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on REVISION OF LAWS since 2004-07-28

rows.author: E004
rows.title_full: AN ACT INCREASING THE SPECIAL GROUP TERM INSURANCE COVERAGE FOR THE MEMBERS OF THE ARMED FORCES OF THE PHILIPPINES, INCLUDING THE MEMBERS OF THE PHILIPPINE NATIONAL POLICE, AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE PRESIDENTIAL DECREE 352, AS AMENDED BY PRESIDENTIAL DECREEE 1965, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: The special group term insurance coverage of Ph12,000.00 extended to members of the Armed Forces of the Philippines (AFP) and the Philippine National Police (PNP) is grossly inadequate for the protection and security of the members and their families. The bill proposes to increase the group insurance coverage for members of the AFP and the PNP from PhP12,000 to not less than PhP50,000.00.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on NATIONAL DEFENSE AND SECURITY since 2004-07-28

rows.author: E004
rows.mother_status: Bill Pending With Rules (Date Included in OB on 2005-09-19)
rows.title_full: AN ACT AMENDING PRESIDENTIAL DECREE NO. 1185, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE \"FIRE CODE OF THE PHILIPPINES\"' PROVIDING FOR EFFECTIVE IMPLEMENTATION THEREOF, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: To strengthen the accountability of public officers charged to implement the Fire Code, this bill proposes to amend the Fire Code of the Philippines by providing administrative sanctions as well as criminal penalties to acts which result in loss of life and/or damage to property.
rows.status: Substituted by HB04667

It introduces the concept of \"full value of contributions\" which shall be used as the basis for the payment to the retirees of their lump sum and the basic monthly pension benefits.

rows.title_short: Omnibus Housing and Urban Development Act of 2004
rows.abstract: \"Omnibus Housing and Urban Development Act of 2004.\" The bill seeks the creation of the Department of Housing and Urban Development (DHUD) which shall be the primary agency tasked with addressing the nation's needs relating to housing, housing finance, land use and resettlement. The DHUD shall undertake a continuing program that will ensure the optimum use of urban lands and resources, and the availability of adequate, affordable and decent shelter and other basic services for the Filipino people.

rows.title_full: AN ACT INCREASING THE BENEFITS OF BARANGAY OFFICIALS, AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE SECTION 393 OF REPUBLIC ACT NO. 7160, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE LOCAL GOVERNMENT CODE OF 1991
rows.abstract: The bill proposes to increase the minimum honoraria, allowances and other emoluments prescribed under Section 393 of the Local Government Code from Php1,000.00 to PhP5,000.00 per month for the punong barangay and from PhP600.00 to PhP4,000.00 per month for each SB member, treasurer and secretary.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on LOCAL GOVERNMENT since 2004-07-28

rows.author: C001
rows.title_full: AN ACT FURTHER AMENDING REPUBLIC ACT NUMBERED NINE HUNDRED AND TEN, AS AMENDED, BY MAKING ITS PROVISIONS APPLICABLE TO PROSECUTORS OF THE NATIONAL PROSECUTION SERVICE, STATE COUNSELS OF THE OFFICE OF THE CHIEF STATE COUNSEL OF THE DEPARTMENT OF JUSTICE, LAWYER OF THE OFFICE OF THE SPECIAL PROSECUTOR AND/OR OF THE OFFICE OF THE OMBUDSMAN, AND PUBLIC ATTORNEY'S OFFICE, APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFORE AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: The measure seeks to further amend RA 910 with the end in view of upgrading the retirement, disability and survivorship benefits of the prosecutors, state counsels, special prosecutors and graft investigators, and public attorneys and place them on equal footing with the members of the Judiciary. The enactment of the bill is expected to result in a more efficient and effective administration of justice in the country.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on CIVIL SERVICE AND PROFESSIONAL REGULATION since 2004-07-28

rows.author: C001
rows.title_full: AN ACT CREATING THE NORTHERN SAMAR TOURIST DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY, AUTHORIZING THE APPROPRIATION OF FUNDS THEREFOR, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on TOURISM since 2004-07-28

rows.author: C001
rows.title_full: AN ACT CREATING THE POSITION OF TOURISM OFFICER IN EACH PROVINCE, CITY AND MUNICIPALITY, AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE CERTAIN SECTIONS OF REPUBLIC ACT NO. 7160, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE LOCAL GOVERNMENT CODE OF 1991
rows.abstract: At present, the development and promotion of tourism is confined only to the Department of Tourism. To fully develop the tourism potentials  in the country, the bill seeks to create the position of Tourism Officer in every province, city, and municipality. The Tourism Officer shall monitor and evaluate the implementation of the different tourism development programs and activities in the local government unit.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on LOCAL GOVERNMENT since 2004-07-28

rows.author: C001
rows.title_full: AN ACT GRANTING THE RIGHT TO FRANCHISES TO DEVELOP THE RURAL AIRPORT INFRASTRUCTURE NETWORK IN THE PHILIPPINES FOR COMMERCIAL AND OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: The bill seeks to grant a francisee the right to construct, manage, operate and maintain a rural airport in any part of the country in order to eventually make each municipality regularly accessible or within easy reach. The establishment of a private rural airport infrastructure will encourage economic activity in the hinterlands by serving not only as transportation hubs but also as industrial, commercial and service centers.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on TRANSPORTATION since 2005-01-12

rows.author: C001
rows.mother_status: Approved by the House on 2006-09-19, transmitted to on 2006-09-26 and received by the Senate on 2006-09-26
rows.title_full: THE SOLAR CONVERSION POWER SYSTEM ACT OF 2001
rows.abstract: The bill aims to encourage the large-scale operation of solar energy systems by mandating the Department of Energy to design a program geared towards the development and manufacture in the Philippines of state-of-the-art-solar conversions power systems. The use of solar energy to produce electricity in the country should be promoted because we have an abundant supply of sunshine and because solar energy is more environment-friendly.
rows.status: Substituted by HB05563

rows.abstract: To deter gambling operations, the bill seeks to impose stiffer penalties to maintainers, financiers, employees and protectors of illegal gambling.  The proposed penalties shall range from prision correccional in its maximum period to prision mayor in its maximum period and fines ranging from PhP50,00 to PhP500,000.

rows.title_full: AN ACT TO UPGRADE THE MINIMUM SALARY GRADE OF PUBLIC SCHOOL TEACHERS FROM SALARY GRADE TEN TO NINETEEN
rows.abstract: The proposed measure seeks to upgrade the salary grade (SG) level of public school teachers from SG 10 to SG 19 for a corresponding increase of almost PhP6,000 in their basic monthly salaries. With the increase in salaries, more qualified and competent educators will be attracted to teach in public schools.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on APPROPRIATIONS since 2004-07-28

rows.author: C001
rows.title_full: AN ACT DEFINING THE CRIME OF PEDOPHILIA AND IMPOSING PENALTIES THEREFOR
rows.abstract: The Constitution mandates the State to defend the rights of children and to afford them special protection from all forms of negligence, abuse cruelty, exploitation and other conditions prejudicial to their development. Towards this end, the bill seeks to declare pedophilia a felony. It also imposes penalties for any violation of the proposed act.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on JUSTICE since 2004-07-28

rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR THE ESTABLISHMENT, DEVELOPMENT AND MAINTENANCE OF PARKS AND MINI-PARKS IN BARANGAYS, MUNICIPALITIES, CITIES AND PROVINCES, PROVIDING FUNDS THEREFOR AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.title_short: Philippine Parks and Mini-Parks Development Act
rows.abstract: \"Philippine Parks and Mini-Parks Development Act.\" The proposed bill seeks to establish, develop and maintain parks and mini-parks in barangay, cities, municipalities and provinces to complement the country's beautification and reforestation program. The proposal likewise supports the clean and green movement of the government.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on PUBLIC WORKS AND HIGHWAYS since 2004-07-28

rows.author: C001
rows.title_full: AN ACT INVESTING IN ALL CITY AND MUNICIPAL MAYORS THE AUTHORITY TO EXERCISE EXCLUSIVE DIRECT OPERATIONAL SUPERVISION AND CONTROL OVER ALL CITY AND MUNICIPAL EMPLOYEES TASKED WITH THE DUTY OR FUNCTIONS OF ISSUING ALL KINDS OF CITY OR MUNICIPAL PERMITS AND LICENSES, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: The Ozone tragedy gave rise to the question as to who was responsible for the actuation of the Quezon City employees over the issuance of certain municipal permits/licenses to business establishments. To clarify the issue, the bill seeks to vest the issuance of all city and municipal permits and licenses under the exclusive direct operational supervision and control of their respective city or municipal mayor, who shall be directly responsible for any act of malfeasance, misfeasance nor non-feasance committed by city or municipal employees in the performance of their assigned tasks.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on LOCAL GOVERNMENT since 2004-07-28

rows.author: C001
rows.title_full: AN ACT TO GRANT MUNICIPAL GOVERNMENT THE EXECUTIVE AUTHORITY TO ISSUE ENVIRONMENTAL CLEARANCE CERTIFICATE (ECC) FOR THE ESTABLISHMENT AND OPERATION OF A POULTRY OR PIGGERY BUSINESS
rows.abstract: At present, poultry and piggery businesses are required to secure a environmental clearance certificate (ECC) from the Department of the Environment and Natural Resources. Because the ECC has to be evaluated and approved by the central office in Manila, the issuance of the ECC may take as long as two years. The bill seeks to grant municipal governments, which have immediate access to where the poultry or piggery is operated, the exclusive authority to issue ECCs for the establishment and operation of a poultry or piggery business with a capital investment of not more than one million pesos.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on LOCAL GOVERNMENT since 2004-07-28

rows.author: C001
rows.title_full: AN ACT IMPOSING PENALTIES ON ANY OWNER/OPERATOR OF A PUBLIC UTILITY VEHICLE VIOLATING THE OUT-OF-LINE OPERATION AND TAMPERING OF LICENSE PLATES, OFFICIAL RECEIPTS, CERTIFICATE OF REGISTRATION OF PUBLIC UTILITY VEHICLES AND/OR CERTIFICATE OF PUBLIC CONVENIENCE AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: The bill penalizes the owner/operator of a public utility vehicle (PUV) violating the out-of-line operation by revoking his Certificate of Public Convenience (CPC) issued by the LTFRB while the CPC of a PUV owner/operator found guilty of colorum operations shall be confiscated. It also provides that any person guilty of tampering with the license plate, official receipt and certificate of registration of PUVs shall be fined PhP50,000.00.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on TRANSPORTATION since 2005-01-12

rows.author: C001
rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING COMPENSATION TO PERSONS WHO ARE KILLED OR INJURED WHILE COMING TO THE AID OR RESCUE OF A VICTIM AND/OR TRYING TO PREVENT A COMMISSION OF A VIOLENT CRIME, AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE REPUBLIC ACT NO. 7309, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: There are many reported cases of heroic deeds performed by plain, ordinary citizens who consider it their duty, at the risk of life and limb, to help maintain peace and order. To give due recognition for these heroic deeds, the bill seeks to provide compensation to persons who are killed or injured while coming to the aid or rescue of a victim or trying to prevent the commission of a violent crime.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on REVISION OF LAWS since 2004-07-28

rows.author: C001
rows.title_full: AN ACT DECLARING CERTAIN POSITIONS IN THE BUREAU OF INTERNAL REVENUE AND BUREAU OF CUSTOMS AS PART OF THE CONFIDENTIAL STAFF OF THE APPOINTING OFFICIALS IN SAID BUREAUS AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: The bill seeks to immunize BIR (Bureau of Internal Revenue) and BOC (Bureau of Customs) officers from graft and corruption practices by declaring the positions of Revenue Officer I, II, III, IV and V and Customs Officers I and II in the BIR and the BOC, respectively, as part of the confidential staff of the appointing officials of said bureaus. As confidential appointees, they may be removed from office for lack of confidence by the appointing authority.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on APPROPRIATIONS since 2004-07-28

rows.author: C001
rows.title_full: AN ACT REGULATING THE SALE OF TICKETS AND COLLECTION OF CONTRIBUTIONS FROM TEACHERS AND STUDENTS, SOLICITATION IN ANY FORM, AND/OR ANY SIMILAR FUND-RAISING ACTIVITY, IN ELEMENTARY AND SECONDARY PUBLIC SCHOOLS, AND PROVIDING PENALTIES FOR VIOLATIONS THEREFOR, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: Although the collection of contributions from school children of public primary and intermediate schools is prohibited under RA 4206, fund-raising activities remain the whole year round. The bill seeks to regulate the sale of tickets and collection of contributions and/or solicitation in any form from teachers and students in elementary and secondary public schools. It proposes that fund-raising activities be undertaken by the parents-teachers association instead.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on BASIC EDUCATION AND CULTURE since 2004-07-28

rows.abstract: The proposed measure seeks to grant a 20% discount on the purchase of prepaid cellcards by a senior citizen whose annual income does not exceed PhP120,000.00. rows.abstract: \"Freedom of Access to Information Act.\" In line with every citizen's right to be informed on the workings of the government, the bill seeks to implement the right of access to information on matters of public concern. rows.status: Pending with the Committee on AQUACULTURE AND FISHERIES RESOURCES since 2005-01-12

rows.author: C001
rows.title_full: AN ACT TO UPGRADE THE SALARY SCALE OF A RETIRING GOVERNMENT EMPLOYEE BY ONE GRADE FOR PURPOSES OF HIS/HER RETIREMENT
rows.abstract: The bill seeks to upgrade the salary scale of a retiring government employee by one salary grade on the date of his/her retirement. The upgraded salary scale shall be the basis for the computation of the retirement benefits of the retiring employee. For an employee who opts to retire under existing laws, the one salary grade increase shall be deemed granted one year before retirement for purposes of service requirement only.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on CIVIL SERVICE AND PROFESSIONAL REGULATION since 2004-07-28

rows.author: C001
rows.title_full: AN ACT REQUIRING GOVERNMENT-OWNED AND/OR CONTROLLED CORPORATIONS TO SUBMIT THEIR ANNUAL BUDGETS TO CONGRESS AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: In consonance with the Constitutional mandate granting Congress the power of the purse, the measure requires all government-owned and controlled corporations to submit their annual budget to Congress for scrutiny and approval. It also requires these entities to secure congressional approval before they incur any obligation or make payments for current operating or capital expenditures.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on APPROPRIATIONS since 2004-07-28

rows.author: C001
rows.title_full: AN ACT ESTABLISHING THE BARANGAY INTEGRATED DEVELOPMENT APPROACH FOR NUTRITION IMPROVEMENT (BIDANI OF THE RURAL POOR AS A NETWORK PROGRAM OF THE PARTICIPATING STATE COLLEGES AND UNIVERSITIES, AND APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR
rows.abstract: \"BIDANI Act of 2001.\" The bill seeks to institutionalize the Barangay Integrated Development Approach for Nutrition Improvement (BIDANI) network program to provide a lasting solution to the problem of malnutrition. It calls for the involvement of academic institutions and local government units in promoting the importance of nutrition. The BIDANI program shall complement traditional nutrition intervention.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on HEALTH since 2004-07-28

rows.author: C001
rows.title_full: AN ACT TO ACCORD GOVERNMENT EMPLOYEES A COMMUTABLE FIVE WORKING DAYS LEAVE OF ABSENCE, WITH PAY, IN ADDITION TO EXISTING LEAVE BENEFITS GRANTED TO THEM, IN CASE ANY MEMBER OF HIS/HER FAMILY DIES
rows.abstract: To give government employees adequate time to take care of the needs attendant to a death in the family, the bill grants a commutable 5-working day leave of absence, with pay in addition to existing leave benefits, in case an immediate relative such as a parent, spouse, brother, sister and child passes away.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on CIVIL SERVICE AND PROFESSIONAL REGULATION since 2004-07-28

rows.author: C001
rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR A UNIFORM REWARD SYSTEM IN THE CAMPAIGN AGAINST CRIMES AND LAWLESSNESS
rows.abstract: The bill grants monetary incentive for individuals who voluntarily furnish information which may lead to the arrest of a fugitive or wanted criminal. It provides the government with an effective weapon to ferret, subdue and destroy racketeers and carpetbaggers. Cash benefits received by government-informers shall be exempt from taxes.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on PUBLIC ORDER AND SAFETY since 2004-07-28

rows.author: C001
rows.title_full: AN ACT REQUIRING THE PAYMENT OF REAL PROPERTY TAXES AS A CONDITION PRIOR TO THE ISSUANCE OF BUILDING PERMIT OR CERTIFICATE OF REGISTRATION OF MACHINERY
rows.abstract: Tax on real properties is one of the major sources of revenue for local government units. The bill requires all applicants for a permit for the construction, addition, repair or renovation of a building to pay the corresponding real property taxes due on the property where the construction would be made prior to the release of the permit.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on LOCAL GOVERNMENT since 2004-07-28

rows.author: C001
rows.title_full: AN ACT CONVERTING THE SAN JOSE TECHNICAL SCHOOL IN THE MUNICIPALITY OF SAN JOSE, PROVINCE OF NORTHERN SAMAR, INTO A MERCHANT MARINE SCHOOL, TO BE KNOWN AS SAN JOSE MERCHANT MARINE COLLEGE, CONFERRING THE DEGREES OF BACHELOR OF SCIENCE IN MARINE TRANSPORTATION, MAJOR IN NAVIGATION AND SEMANSHIP, AND BACHELOR OF SCIENCE IN MARINE TRANSPORTATION, MAJOR IN STEAM ENGINE AND ELECTRICAL ENGINEERING, PROVIDING FOR A MERCHANT MARINE COLLEGE BOARD DEFINING ITS POWERS AND DUTIES, APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on HIGHER AND TECHNICAL EDUCATION since 2004-07-28

rows.author: C001
rows.title_full: AN ACT PUNISHING ANY OFFICER OR EMPLOYEE OF THE LAND TRANSPORTATION OFFICE WHO IS RESPONSIBLE FOR REGISTERING STOLEN MOTOR VEHICLE, INSERTING FOR THE PURPOSE A NEW SECTION BETWEEN SECTIONS FIFTY-SEVEN AND FIFTY-EIGHT OF REPULIC ACT NUMBERED FORTY-ONE HUNDRED THIRTY SIX
rows.abstract: The bill seeks to punish an officer or employee of the office responsible for the registration of a stolen vehicle with a fine equivalent to the market value of the stolen vehicle or imprisonment of not less than one year. If found guilty, the employee shall be dimissed from the service and shall forfeit all benefits/privileges due him.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on TRANSPORTATION since 2005-01-12

rows.author: C001
rows.title_full: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A CIVIL SERVICE CODE OF THE PHILIPPINES AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: The bill updates all civil service related laws to conform with the 1987 Constitution and with present day needs and realities. It addresses the problems of graft and corruption, red tape, violations of employees' rights, violations of merit and fitness principle, among others. It codifies the various laws and other issuances into one comprehensive law.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on CIVIL SERVICE AND PROFESSIONAL REGULATION since 2004-07-28

rows.author: C001
rows.title_full: AN ACT ESTABLISHING THE \"PALUWAGAN NG BAYAN\", DEFINING ITS PURPOSES AND OBJECTIVES, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: \"Paluwagan ng Bayan Act.\" The bill makes available to the marginalized sectors of our society credit without collateral to finance livelihood projects. The funds for the paluwagan shall be channeled through accredited non-governmental organizations. The funds shall be sourced from existing funds earmarked for livelihood projects, grants and donations.
rows.status: Tabled by the Committee on 2005-05-03

rows.author: C001
rows.title_full: AN ACT AMENDING REPUBLIC ACT NO. 337, AS AMENDED, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE GENERAL BANKING ACT, REQUIRING BANKS AND OTHER FINANCIAL INSTITUIONS TO SECURE CERTIFICATION FROM THE BUREAU OF INTERNAL REVENUE ON THE AUTHENTICITY OF DOCUMENTS REQUIRED FOR LOAN APPROVAL PRIOR TO GRANTING SUCH, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: It is the practice of many entities to maintain two sets of financial statements - one understating income for tax purposes and the other overstating income for loan purposes. To stop this practice, the bill requires banks and other financial institutions to approve loans based on audited financial statements duly certified by the Bureau of Internal Revenue as the same statement submitted to them.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on BANKS AND FINANCIAL INTERMEDIARIES since 2004-07-28
